# Goal
tabi round 24, attempt 1 (hyaku run 6). Baseline lane tip 573c99e4885382db38babc3a6fc90e77afeb42a6.
Three claims are FROZEN before data in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-24/claims.json — read it first, it is authoritative.
C1 (operability, lowest non-retired tie at 8): a fail-closed gate-registry conformance gate
`scripts/check-gate-registry.mjs` that reads a revision's committed bytes and reports how many of the lane's
gates lack a complete registry row (PROTOCOL §Gate standard: eight fields) in SKILL.md, the lane's registry
home. Target: N at baseline -> 0 at tip. Round-23's non-author spot-check routed defect 1 is exactly this:
`grep -c round-evidence-audit SKILL.md` -> 0 at the reviewed tip.
C2 (calibration): `scripts/check-selfassessment.mjs` counts mismatches between the lane's self-assessment
(SCORECARD.md blocks naming a gate script; SHONEN.md) and observed repo state — m1 stale `--selftest` /
N-case tallies, m2 committed receipt exits that a re-run contradicts, m3 unlanded working-tree paths while
the lane asserts landed rounds. Target: 4 -> 0. Routed defects 2 and 4 are exactly this: three stale
"12/12" figures against a shipped 13-case matrix, and 89 unlanded porcelain paths.
C3 (coverage): ONE knowledge entry on an unheld browser-interaction surface — navigation-history evidence
across a back/forward-cache restore (a history.back() step served from bfcache emits no network request and
restores live JS state, so "no network events" cannot be read as "no navigation") — admitted only after this
lane re-opens every cited source itself this round, with two new SOURCES rows carrying this round's access
date and located quotes (<=25 words). Before 0 -> after 1 admitted entry citing a row first opened this round.
No axis is promoted on a scalar; no non-author judgment is asserted anywhere (every seat is lane-dispatched).
The round's other mandated work (not a claim): the round-23 M5 scratch over-commit is removed (1,034 committed
scratch paths -> the cited evidence preserved, the rest deleted), the 89 unlanded paths are resolved, and the
round-23 receipt/exit claim is re-checked rather than assumed.

# Contract
Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin; every path you use is absolute. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to
/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/<that path>. You are a READ-ONLY reporter: write ONLY the single report file
named in your item (inside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-24/) plus throwaway fixtures under
/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-24/scratch/<YourName>/. Never edit tracked repo files (SKILL.md, LOG.md,
SCORECARD.md, corpus/**, PROVINCE.md, scripts/**), never run git/jj writes (no add/commit/push/checkout/
switch/reset/stash/rm, no mutating jj), never touch the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin, any sibling
lane, or /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (read-only). Never run builds/linters/formatters; the L1 runs the
lane gates once after integration. Never spawn or delegate (no nested swarms), never message other seats or
broadcast, never start services, never open a browser, never probe external sites beyond the single
documented HTTP GET your item names, never touch credentials or session material. Use read-only git only
(log, show, ls-tree, grep, cat-file, rev-parse, merge-base). Tooling authorization (operator 2026-10-19):
you may install or upgrade tools that help your task after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md
(official channels only; record tool/version/channel/reason in your report). PACMAN GUARD (orchestrator
2026-10-20): all pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide — use uv tool / npx / an official binary in
~/.local/bin, or file nothing and report the need; never run pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R.
Evidence discipline: every number you state carries the exact command that produced it; observation,
inference and unknown stay separate; a negative claim carries its sweep; a quote names its location.

# API of the two gates the L1 will write (your item may critique or specify them, never write them)
`node scripts/check-gate-registry.mjs --rev <40-hex-rev> [--json] [--selftest]` prints
{schema, rev, gates:[{name, script, row, missing:[fields]}], nonconformant:N, clean:boolean} and exits 0 when
clean, 1 when any nonconformant gate, 2 on usage/IO refusal. A gate's latest row wins (later rows supersede
earlier ones in document order). `--selftest` runs isolated CLI cases asserting exit + finding id.
`node scripts/check-selfassessment.mjs --rev <40-hex-rev> [--json] [--selftest]` prints
{schema, rev, mismatches:N, findings:[{class, doc, line, claimed, observed}], clean:boolean} and exits 0 clean,
1 on any mismatch, 2 on usage/IO refusal. Classes: m1-selftest-tally, m2-receipt-exit, m3-unlanded-paths.
